intro: Please read this disclaimer before using our website or services.
body: Indian Visa Online Service is a private company offering help with Indian visa applications. We are not the Government of India, the High Commission of India or any embassy or consulate, and we do not issue visas.
You can apply for an Indian e-Visa yourself on the official website, indianvisaonline.gov.in, and pay only the government fee. Our service fee is charged in addition to the government fee.

The information on this website is general guidance based on the official rules at the time of writing. Indian visa rules change, so always check the latest position before you travel. All visa decisions are made by the Indian authorities.
